About Wild & Woven

For the wanderers, the wild ones, the barefoot dancers and the beautifully unconventional.

Wild & Woven brings 100% natural-fibre handmade clothing, with a love for earthy textures, relaxed fits, playful prints and pieces that are made to move with you — clothes for wherever the adventure takes you.
